lines: Russo-Ukrainian war Zaporizhzhia strikes, Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war A Russian airstrike hits a five-story apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, killing two people and wounding 44 others. (AP)
Gaza war Israel claims to have killed Hamas security official Naeem Abu Nahel in a airstrike in the Gaza Strip. (The Washington Post)
Thirteen people are killed and fourteen others are injured when a bus collides with a stationary truck in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. (Gulf News)
Seven people are killed and nine others are injured in a cooking gas explosion at a hot pot restaurant in Hanoi, Vietnam. (VnExpress)
A Turkish Air Force helicopter crashes during a training flight in Eskişehir, Turkey, killing five crew members. (AP)

Climate change in the United Kingdom 2026 United Kingdom heatwaves The UK Health Security Agency says it recorded the highest number of heat-related deaths in the United Kingdom on record in 2026 at 5,258, surpassing the previous record in 2022. (Reuters)
Aftermath of the July Uprising Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announces she plans to return to the country on December 16, coinciding with Victory Day. (Reuters)

2025 Africa Cup of Nations In association football, the Court of Arbitration for Sport rules in favor of Senegal against Morocco and reverses the Confederation of African Football's controversial decision to overturn Senegal's 1–0 victory in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final. (AP) (The Guardian)
Armed men in Cartagena, Colombia took 25 people hostage in a supermarket after a failed armored-car robbery. (Aliazeera)
